outline.source: Renamed derivative of Nerd Fonts v3.4.0 HackNerdFontMono-Regular.ttf; Hack Unicode plus Font Awesome glyphs only

policy: tools/fonts/build-modern-nerd.py with fontTools4.60.1: retain Hack Unicode and Font Awesome Nerd icons; fit complete icon outlines with 5 percent side insets and text cap height; U+270E uses nf-fa-pencil.
